synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) move by 6; blocks fully on the beam (any tag) are carried, and moved rects push other blocks in a chain.
Arm A1 [block,player] no_change = carried/pushed blocks would leave the colour-4 field at the top, so the whole vertical move cancels.
Step-87: hook and on-beam drag are tag-agnostic, so todo blocks follow the extending tip +6. Blocked horizontal chains move the beam alone.
Tags: hooked next with other on-beam blocks collected -> collected; collected off the beam -> next. Legend icon centre 0 when collected.
HUD row: 3s = (n-1)//3, n = non-click actions, remembered per returned frame (fallback 3*threes+1). A5/A7 unconfirmed.
